bio_en: Traditional Chan genealogies count Jianatipo as Indian patriarch number 15, following Longshu. They name Luohouluoduo as his successor; these lineage accounts do not provide an independently established biography.
bio_summary: 迦那提婆即聖天，承龍樹中觀之學，著《百論》《廣百論》以破諸執。禪門又列為西天二十八祖第十五祖，此屬宗門傳統譜系。
